features.name: BasicSuspension
features.description: Single-page app demonstrating UWP suspend/resume state preservation. The page shows a ListView (header 'Click on an item or click a button in the AppBar.') populated with items, plus a bottom CommandBar with 'add' and 'reset' AppBarButtons. Clicking an item navigates to a SubPage; suspension state (selected item / list contents) is saved and restored via SuspensionManager.

requiredControls.name: list
requiredControls.label: Click on an item or click a button in the AppBar.

expectedActions.effect: adds an item to the list
resets the list to its default items
navigates to SubPage for the clicked item

features.passCriteria: MainPage renders the ListView with its header text and items, and the add/reset CommandBar buttons are present and wired. Item click navigates to SubPage. Suspend/resume preserves state.

notes: Checklist extracted from source lists 1 scenario / 1 control (the ListView) / 0 declared actions; the add/reset buttons live in the page BottomAppBar/CommandBar and are captured separately. The ListView is the structural gate control.
